customization.summary: Model-mediated Python execution with fixed libraries and 30-second maximum runtime. Model/prompt/thinking/tool combinations and media inputs can vary; no container image/resource customization. Adapter defaults to gemini-2.5-flash text-only GenerateContent.

features.notes: No hosted container image selector. Gemini 3 Flash image inspection/output refers to media, not OS images; not tested by text-only 2.5 Flash adapter.
Official guides explicitly prohibit own library installation; fixed preinstalled libraries.
Tool contract exposes no vCPU selector; model selection is not resource sizing.
No RAM selector. README's approximate 1 GB/50 KB stdout numbers not verified in current official guides or report.
No selectable sandbox GPU; preinstalled TensorFlow does not establish accelerator access.

No configurable network control in inspected tool request; historical model-mediated output reports blocked DNS/HTTP/metadata without retained tool trace. Search/custom tools do not grant Python network access.
No durable sandbox storage/mount interface in documented tool. Files API/model context and scratch writes are not persistent interpreter disk.

Current multi-turn conversations/previous_interaction_id documented but persistent Python kernel memory/files not established. Adapter creates independent GenerateContent calls; reported five turns occur inside one program.
Python-only first-class tool; no SSH/command/shell endpoint. Subprocess probes do not establish a supported shell service.

Developer API inline/Files API input, inline graph/image output with model-dependent behavior. Vertex guide excludes file URI I/O and documents inline bytes. Adapter does not submit files or retrieve inline artifacts.
No port forwarding/service preview contract in built-in tool.
Google-hosted built-in execution. External function-calling runtimes are separate products/deployments.
No tool-runtime CMEK selector or coverage verified. Separate Google Cloud sandbox CMEK must not be inherited.

pricing.model: No separate Code Execution runtime/session charge; token billing for selected model, including code/results and iterative context. Quoted rates are Developer API Standard paid gemini-2.5-flash only.

rates.resource: gemini-2.5-flash Standard paid output including thinking

pricing.limitations: Developer rates do not establish a Vertex regional quote, or Batch/Flex/Priority rates. Adapter sends text only. Generated code/results are output when created and can be input in iterative reasoning; actual usage metadata required. Fixed 500/250 report tokens and $0.0001125 costs are estimates. No supported dated price-increase comparison.

tested_configuration.requested: Default gemini-2.5-flash, text prompt, ToolCodeExecution() through async GenerateContent; default resource environment. See tested-configurations.json for versioned requests.
tested_configuration.limitations: New trials require exact source plus successful tool outcome; prose fallback rejected. Runtime observations are not allocations. No artifact collection, cross-request kernel proof, newer media workflow or metered token bill.
